incident: WSL VM stopped during the pair explorer loop
timeline_kst: 01:16:07 explorer round 21 processing stage (validate/dedupe/pair, 2-4 s CPU each); no memory pressure
01:16:57 systemd starts an orderly shutdown (timers/services stopped in order); fetch receives SIGTERM (rc=143)
01:18:03 boot on the new kernel, 01:19:18 orderly shutdown, 01:19:54 boot

01:46-02:33 WSL boot loop: '/sbin/init failed to start within 10000ms' x2062, dxg ioctl errors, every boot renames the journal as unclean (journal grew to 809 MB and rotated away the logs before 01:46)
root_cause: external: automatic WSL package update shut the VM down; the following boot loop is a WSL/Windows-side problem. No OOM, no kernel panic, no formbench process above a few hundred MB.
weaknesses_found: the memory scope can silently become unavailable (seen as 'memory controller not delegated' while the user manager was stopping); heavy commands would then run with only the per-job watchdog
PairExplorer.reset_stale existed but was never called; a page left 'visiting' by the shutdown would never be visited again
after the VM restart the loop does not resume by itself; idle rounds re-ran the processing stage every few minutes
the system journal is not a reliable record across WSL restarts
fixes: resources.ensure_memory_scope: heavy commands (benchmark, reconstruct, render, reproduce, experiment, pilot) exit 4 (blocked_by_environment) without a kernel-enforced scope unless FORMBENCH_MEM_GUARD=off; other commands get an in-process tree watchdog at the scope budget
resources.log_event -> data/logs/resources.jsonl: every CLI start (scope state, limit, MemAvailable, boot_id), scope unavailability, per-job memory kills and host-pressure requeues

PairExplorer.reset_stale also forgets pages stuck in 'visiting'; `formbench collect explore-pairs --reset-stale`; scripts/explore_loop_v2.sh runs it once at start, holds a flock (one loop), records boot_id and sleeps on idle rounds
not_fixable_here: journald size cap (SystemMaxUse) needs root; /var/log/journal is 809 MB after the boot loop
WSL automatic updates / boot loop are controlled on the Windows side
data_integrity: SQLite integrity_check ok; no explorer query left running; 1 page requeued
